binding_site_detail: Walker A motif (ATP-binding site) in NACHT domain
mechanism: Direct binding blocks ATP binding and NLRP3 ATPase; inhibits oligomerization and ASC recruitment
IC50_KD: Kd=0.5 µM (MST on NACHT); cellular IL-1β IC50~6 µM (BMDM LPS/nigericin)
ATPase_inhibition: Yes (dose-dependent inhibition of purified NLRP3 ATPase)
key_residues: Walker A (K232 region); competes with ATP
notes: Originally misattributed to Nature Medicine in prior notes; journal is JEM. Selective for NLRP3 vs AIM2/NLRC4.

mechanism: Covalent Michael addition to Cys279 blocks NLRP3-NEK7 interaction and inflammasome assembly
IC50_KD: IL-1β IC50~0.75 µM (BMDM); in vivo 3-20 mg/kg
ATPase_inhibition: Indirect (blocks NEK7 binding not Walker pocket directly)
key_residues: Cys279 (human); mouse rescue experiments used C275A mutant
notes: Prior error: Cys273 was incorrect. Human target is Cys279; mouse ortholog tested as C275A. Low oral bioavailability (<5% in rodents).

mechanism: Direct NACHT binding blocks NLRP3-NLRP3 oligomerization; ATPase-independent
assay_cells: BMDM; human PBMC; synovial fluid cells
IC50_KD: Effective at low µM in macrophages (e.g. 10 µM blocks ~80% IL-1β in BMDM)
notes: Does not affect K+ efflux mitochondrial damage or chloride efflux. Selective vs AIM2/NLRC4.

mechanism: Covalent bromoacetyl alkylation of Cys409 blocks NLRP3-NEK7 interaction
IC50_KD: Low nM potency reported in review (IC50 context assay-dependent)
clinical_status: Phase III (oncology SCLC); NLRP3 mechanism published 2021
notes: Also targets Keap1 Myc hemoglobin Cys93. Blocks canonical noncanonical and alternative NLRP3 pathways.

mechanism: Michael addition alkylates Cys548; blocks NLRP3-NEK7 interaction
assay_cells: BMDM; Irg1-/- BMDM; CAPS patient PBMC
IC50_KD: Endogenous itaconate and 4-OI active at low µM
species_selectivity: Mouse primary data; human CAPS PBMC ex vivo
notes: Human NLRP3 lacks direct C548 homolog; human mechanism may differ. Endogenous IRG1/ACOD1 product.

binding_site_detail: NLRP3 NACHT surface groove (FISNA+WHD+NBD β-sheet); distinct from MCC950 pocket
mechanism: Binds NACHT without inhibiting ATPase; stabilizes inactive decamer; additive with MCC950
IC50_KD: DEL IC50=25 nM; THP-1+nigericin IC50=57.5 nM; KD=110 nM (SPR NACHT; Torp 2025)
key_residues: Y258 H260 β2 strand; lead for BAL-1516 series
species_selectivity: Human and primate potent; poor mouse NLRP3 inhibition
notes: Discovery: Hartman 2024 BMCL. Structural details resolved by optimized analog BAL-1516 (Torp bioRxiv 2025).

binding_site_detail: NBD surface groove adjacent to AAA+ β-sheet; contacts FISNA and WHD; opposite ADP; distinct from MCC950
mechanism: Binds via 3 H-bonds to NBD β2 strand (Glu-switch); does not inhibit ATP hydrolysis; additive binning with MCC950
assay_cells: HEK293T ASC-BFP; monocytes; PBMC; iPSC microglia
IC50_KD: KD=14.2 nM (human NACHT SPR); mouse NACHT KD=200 nM; ASC speck IC50=14.5 nM; microglia IL-1β IC50=11 nM
key_residues: Y258 H260 F257 I259; near Cys279 and Cys514; (R)-chiral centre essential
species_selectivity: CNS-penetrant (Kp~0.1-0.3); binds mouse NLRP3 (improved vs BAL-0028)
notes: First co-crystal of BAL series. Optimized from BAL-0028 for BBB penetration. PDB status HPUB (hold until publication).

mechanism: Oral bioavailable derivative; in vivo NLRP3 inhibition in humanized NLRP3 peritonitis model
notes: Optimized for in vivo efficacy vs BAL-0028.

binding_site_detail: PYD domain Cys108 and Cys130 (plus other NLRP3 cysteines)
mechanism: Intermolecular covalent crosslinking of NLRP3 causes HMW aggregates and blocks inflammasome assembly
IC50_KD: Potent in cell screen (0.03-0.3 µM range in table)
notes: Originally developed as USP14/UCHL5 DUB inhibitor. Novel mechanism distinct from pocket binders.

mechanism: NACHT and LRR domains; covalent cysteine modification near ATP site inhibits ATPase and ASC speck formation
notes: Originally identified as Syk inhibitor but NLRP3 effect is Syk-independent. Bay11-7082 competes for same cysteine region.

binding_site_detail: Proposed Cys419 near ATP-binding pocket (homology model; not fully validated)
mechanism: Irreversible covalent Michael acceptor inhibits NLRP3 ATPase
IC50_KD: ATPase IC50=74 µM; pyroptosis IC50=23.2 µM (1h preincubation)
notes: Cys419 assignment from homology model (NLRC4 template); needs experimental validation.

mechanism: Covalent acrylate warhead blocks NLRP3 ATPase and NEK7-NLRP3 interaction
notes: Lower cytotoxicity/reactivity than INF4E and INF58. Selective vs AIM2/NLRC4.

mechanism: NACHT binding inhibits ATPase and blocks NLRP3-ASC and NLRP3-caspase-1 interactions
IC50_KD: IC50=1 nM (J774 IL-1β); active at nM in human macrophages
notes: Prior error: not Nature Medicine. Independent group (Teske 2024) disputed direct NLRP3 inhibition at relevant concentrations—see notes in README.

binding_site_detail: Alkylates cysteines in NLRP3 ATPase region; also inhibits IKKβ NF-κB and other targets
figure_url: Also modifies GSDMD Cys191 and caspase-1. Not suitable as selective NLRP3 drug.

binding_site_detail: NLRP3 ATPase region and direct caspase-1 inhibition
mechanism: Inhibits NLRP3 ATPase and caspase-1 catalytic activity; blocks ASC oligomerization
notes: Multi-target anti-inflammatory agent; same paper as Bay11-7082.

mechanism: Alkylation suppresses ATPase; enhances NLRP3 ubiquitination
notes: Dual NF-κB and NLRP3 effects; safety not thoroughly validated in vivo.

mechanism: Reduces mtROS upstream of NLRP3; not direct NLRP3 binder
notes: Not a direct NLRP3 ligand; included for mechanism comparison only.

mechanism: Primarily blocks priming (signal 1) via KEAP1-NRF2; weak direct NLRP3 claims
notes: Primarily affects signal 1 not direct NLRP3 binding; often grouped with NLRP3 inhibitors in reviews.
